receptor.title: Wrana et al. · Nature 1994
receptor.supports: TGFβ binds receptor II, which recruits and phosphorylates receptor I.

assembly.title: Radaev et al. · JBC 2010; Zúñiga et al. · JMB 2005
assembly.supports: TGFβ1 receptor complex architecture and cooperative receptor recruitment; paired type I/type II receptor stoichiometry also follows PMID 16289576.
assembly.reading: Primary abstract and available figure captions read. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16289576/

gs.title: Wieser et al. · EMBO J 1995
gs.supports: Receptor II phosphorylation of the type I receptor GS region; regulatory GS sites are distinct from downstream catalytic function.

smad-p.title: Liu et al. · PNAS 1997; RBPMS study · EMBO J 2006
smad-p.supports: SMAD3 C-terminal phosphorylation is required for the canonical transcriptional response; S423/S425 sites are separately identified in the RBPMS study.
smad-p.reading: Primary abstract read; S423/S425 mutant description read in a search-indexed primary excerpt of https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1500973/. Direct full-text access returned a CAPTCHA; full text was not inspected.

trimer.title: Chacko et al. · Molecular Cell 2004
trimer.supports: Two phosphorylated R-SMAD subunits and one SMAD4 subunit in SMAD3/SMAD4 and SMAD2/SMAD4 heterotrimer structures.

import.title: Xu et al. · JBC 2003
import.supports: SMAD3 and SMAD4 nuclear transport through nucleoporin interactions; the animation combines transport into one step and does not assert a sole import route.
import.reading: Primary abstract read. Complex nuclear translocation also supported by https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9732876/.

dna.title: Zawel et al. · Molecular Cell 1998
dna.supports: SMAD3 and SMAD4 recognize DNA response sequences. The artwork uses generic DNA without an asserted sequence.

transcription.title: Feng et al. · Genes & Development 1998
transcription.supports: SMAD3, SMAD4 and CBP/p300 cooperate in TGFβ-induced transcription. Cofactors and polymerase are combined in the RNA-output step.
transcription.reading: Primary abstract read; no quantitative gene-expression simulation.
